answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, converted to a slow vesting stream, idle agents bleed standing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The opal lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the glacier is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The quill of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
